name: Rune
source_text: You can summon a Ritual Unit from the Extra Deck by Tributing a Unit that has the required Runes

name: Retain
source_text: This card is not discarded at the end of your turn. at the start of your turn reduce Retain by 1

name: Reveal
source_text: A card with Reveal is face up

name: Eternal
source_text: The first time this Unit would be destroyed it is not, reduce Eternal by 1

name: Burn
source_text: If this Unit attacks, you lose HP equal to the number of Burn on this Unit and remove all Burn

name: Pierce
source_text: If this Unit attacks a Defense Stance Unit, excess ATK Damages your opponent, reduce Pierce by 1

name: Cleanse
source_text: Remove all Debuffs or prevent a Debuff being Applied, reduce curse by 1.

name: Paralyse
source_text: This Unit cannot declare an attack or move Zone. At the end of your turn reduce Paralyse by 1

name: Medic
source_text: At the start of your turn gain HP equal to the number of Medic on this Unit, reduce Medic by 1

name: Curse
source_text: Remove all Buffs or prevent a Buff being Applied, reduce curse by 1.

name: Poison
source_text: At the end of your turn lose HP equal to the number of Poison on this Unit, reduce Poison by 1

name: Infiltrate
source_text: This Unit can attack Protected Units. If it attacks a Protected Unit reduce Infiltrate by 1

name: Blind
source_text: If this Unit attacks, the target is selected at random. If it attacks reduce Blind by 1

name: Nimble
source_text: Once per turn this Unit can move to an Adjacent Zone, reduce Nimble by 1

name: Debilitate
source_text: Unit cannot be Sacrificed, Tributed, or use its Effects. At the end of your turn reduce Debilitate by 1
